compiled_state.title: [preplanning]: Bypass mechanism stories lack paired governance story -> Audit/justification specified but never implemented
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 5d5f6e904dd3c8d731c8fcd956fb288790b884c9
* **Skill:** plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (planning-model defect)

**Filed by d076 post-mortem analysis (`docs/findings/d076-postmortem-analysis.md`) — implementation deferred to a remediation sprint.**

#### Expected Behavior

When preplanning decomposes a story that introduces a bypass mechanism (env var of the form DSO_*_BYPASS or DSO_*=0; CLI flags --force-*, --override-*, --bypass-*; "emergency" hook escape hatches), the preplanning prompt must require a paired governance story with the following deliverables: (a) write an audit log entry every time the bypass is invoked; (b) require a non-empty justification companion variable or CLI flag; (c) surface a count of invocations to /dso:end-session and file a follow-up if ≥N. The bypass story and the governance story must both be in the epic's preplanning context and linked by a depends_on relation.

#### Actual Behavior

f61f's S4 description (story 53be-becc-af70-4f62) spec'd the audit log explicitly: "Escape hatch: setting DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 env var bypasses the hook for emergency commits with an audit log entry." Preplanning broke S4 into tasks; no audit-log task was created. During the d076 sprint, the bypass was invoked ~20 times silently. Bug 660e-4317-620d-44bb captures the gap.

### 3. Action History

The audit-log requirement existed in the brainstorm spec but disappeared at preplanning. The d076 rescue eventually added the audit log + BYPASS_REASON companion as a fix-bug response to 660e (now visible in plugins/dso/scripts/check-session-merge-only.sh).

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

Planning-stage governance pairing is cheaper than rescue-stage retrofit. A bypass mechanism is half a feature; the governance is the other half.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Affected skill: preplanning. Suggested implementation: a checklist item in the preplanning prompt that scans the brainstorm spec for bypass keywords (BYPASS, --force, --override, escape hatch, emergency) and refuses to finalize the story breakdown without a paired governance story.

### 6. Logs

Reference: docs/findings/d076-postmortem-analysis.md §4 H5 + §6 row 4.

comments.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: bypass-mechanism stories (DSO_*_BYPASS / --force-* / --override-* / escape-hatch patterns) introduced by epic specs lack a paired governance story (audit log + justification variable + session-close count report). Proposed fix: add a bypass-keyword scanner to preplanning SKILL.md pre-finalization checklist that scans brainstorm spec text for bypass-pattern matches and blocks story finalization unless a paired governance story is added and linked via depends_on. Classification: MODERATE — single SKILL.md edit. The d076 rescue already implemented the audit log in check-session-merge-only.sh; this bug only requires preplanning to enforce the paired-story pattern at planning time. Not addressed in this P2 pass (focused on highest-value code + 3-bug brainstorm group); leaving OPEN for follow-up.
